title: Uniform norm of an affine sign function
statement: For real numbers $p,a,b$, let a sign be either $-1$ or $1$, with its usual real value. The uniform $L^p$ quantity of the function sending a sign $s$ to $a+bs$ is $\left((|a+b|^p+|a-b|^p)/2\right)^{1/p}$.
